notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Scaretiller.
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
Archelos is untapped.
description:
Activate Crystal Vein's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Crystal Vein from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Scaretiller ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.
